library.title: Submit a corrective action plan for a health facility
library.intro: The facility's plan to put right what an inspection found: each action, who in the facility is responsible for it (a role, not a name) and the date it will be done. The regulator accepts the plan or sets other dates within the periods the law allows.
library.filled_by: The licensed facility's operator or someone acting for it; the regulator accepts it or sets the deadlines at a step of its own.
library.intended: Follow-up of an inspection (health.facility inspection stage, and inspections of licensed facilities): a corrective-action follow-up procedure is not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

nation_values.decision: The period within which each kind of corrective action must be done.

deviations.what: "Actions and deadlines assigned": the facility proposes the dates; the regulator accepts them or sets others at its own step (officer field), within the periods the nation's rules set
deviations.why: No corrective-action procedure exists yet, and a deadline is the regulator's act, never the applicant's.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: a status change is an authorised action

deviations.what: Patient consent, emergency clinical access and a shared patient reference do not arise: the form carries no patient, clinical, treatment, diagnosis or individual health field
deviations.why: Allowed scope only: health facility and professional regulation and aggregate statistics.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Health: no patient or clinical field anywhere, no national patient record; owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

quotes: Licensing services should maintain professional and facility records without unnecessarily exposing patient information.

platform.how: No patient, clinical, treatment or diagnosis field: the scope check runs on every key and the conformance test holds it

quotes: Professional or facility status should be disclosed only at the level authorized by law.
A public register might show that a licence is active, while investigation details or protected personal information remain restricted.

platform.how: Public lists and checks carry only publicOrganisation() / the profession's publicFields; investigation fields are restricted

quotes: Apply the configured rule and review path

platform.how: A licence reference must be active in its register (REF-ACTIVE); the approved mapping and its review path decide

quotes: Facility licensing, inspection, and enforcement procedures
Regulatory integrity: Product and professional status comes from the competent authority's authoritative record.

platform.how: Standing comes only from the register kept by the competent authority; forms point to it, never copy it

quotes: Health-professions and facility registry — licensing, renewals, inspections, complaints, and authorized status verification.

platform.how: Licensing, renewals, inspections, complaints and status verification are the contracts of this batch

quotes: Unique facility ID, name, type, location, operator, authorised services, operational status, verification date

platform.how: The facility register keeps the id, name, type, location, operator, services, status and verification date; this form points to it by the facility's number

quotes: Facility, inspection type, findings, evidence, inspector, corrective action, due date defined by applicable rules

hint.en: The facility's number in the register of organisations, as shown on its licence.

en.reference_exists: There is no organisation with that number in the register.
en.REF-ACTIVE: The facility's licence in the register is not active.

hint.en: As shown on the inspection report the facility received.
One entry for each corrective action the inspection required.

en.required: Add at least one entry to the corrective actions.
Enter the finding or requirement it answers.
en.length: Finding or requirement it answers must be 200 characters or fewer.

en.required: Enter what the facility will do.
en.length: What the facility will do must be 2000 characters or fewer.

hint.en: A role, for example facility manager. No names are needed.

en.required: Enter the role responsible in the facility.
en.length: Role responsible in the facility must be 120 characters or fewer.

en.required: Enter the date it will be done.
en.date_not_before: Date it will be done must be today or later.
